decision.thesis: No entry. The account is flat, so there is nothing to manage and the only question is whether to open. This check builds on the 22:00 research note rather than repeating it, and it is the hardest call of the day because the complex reversed and XRPUSDT did, on the surface, exactly what the 21:00 note asked for in advance: it broke above 1.4969 and printed a new 24h high of 1.5077 at 15:05Z. The 22:00 note set the bar for re-opening XRP as a long at 'back above 1.4894 and holding, with volume on the up bars rather than the down ones'. Price cleared the level; the other two halves of that condition failed, and the trade's geometry is unsound. (1) VOLUME FAILS, and it was the named precondition. The heaviest 5m bar of the entire recovery window is 671,693,997 at 14:55Z, and it is a DOWN bar: it opened 1.5022, rejected from a 1.5039 high and closed 1.4963. Hourly participation on the reclaiming hour contracted rather than expanded, 4,055,848,100 in the 14Z hour against 4,089,988,720 in the 13Z hour. The one hour that took price to new highs did so on less volume than the hour before it, and the largest single bar in it was the rejection. (2) IT IS NOT HOLDING. The breakout is eight minutes old at decision time and has already given back more than half of the bar that made it: high 1.5077 and close 1.5049 at 15:05Z, ask 1.5015 at 15:13Z, which is below that close. The strategy is explicit that a fresh breakout in the erratic hours after the US open is not evidence yet, and this one is fading while being looked at. (3) THE GEOMETRY DOES NOT WORK, and this is the decisive structural point. The nearest valid overhead level is 1.5270 (2026-08-24 daily high), 1.70% above the entry, while XRP's own 14Z hourly bar spanned 1.4765 to 1.5039, a range of 1.83%. The target is closer than one hour of this contract's current range, so it is not a 24-hour objective with an edge in front of it; it is inside the noise. Every stop that is structurally honest fails the floor against that target: 1.4700 (the prior structural low) prints 0.70 net, 1.4765 (the failed-breakout low this leg reversed from) prints 0.86, and 1.4880 (below the reclaimed 1.4894 level) prints exactly 1.50 with zero margin. The only comfortable passes come from stops at 1.4930 or 1.4940, which is choosing a stop to fit a size: 1.4945 printed as a low twice inside the last fifteen minutes, so those stops sit five to fifteen ticks below a price the market traded minutes ago, inside a tape whose last twelve 5m bars average 0.0058 of range and include bars of 0.0094 and 0.0107. (4) THE 1.50 PRINT WAS REACHED BY PRICE FALLING, NOT BY EVIDENCE ARRIVING. At 15:10Z the ask was 1.5025 and the 1.4880-stop construction printed 1.46, below the floor. Three minutes later the ask had drifted to 1.5015 and the identical construction printed 1.50. The 22:00 note named this exact trap in advance for ETHUSDT - 'a fall that clears the floor by pushing the entry down is worth less than one where the evidence also arrives' - and declining to act on a ratio that crossed the line on a 0.0010 drift, with zero margin above the minimum, while the named volume condition is unmet, is the same discipline that rejected ETH at 1.40 an hour ago. Even the 1.4880 stop is inside one hourly bar of current tape: price traded 1.4792, below it, only 65 minutes ago. On evidence, price_action is present but weak and unconfirmed, market_context is supportive, and trend restates market_context rather than adding to it - the 22:00 note already ruled those two one observation, not two - while volume, the category that would have made the case independent, argues the other way. ETHUSDT is now the clearest rejection of the day: it moved away from the 2722.68 threshold the 22:00 note named, to an ask of 2745.69, and prints 0.38 net on the unchanged 2693.00/2771.00 structure, a fifth consecutive failure after 1.34, 0.55, 1.40 and 0.45. BTCUSDT is excluded on two fresh artifacts printed this hour, an 11.6% upper wick to 95804.10 at both 14:35Z and 14:40Z with no counterpart on any other contract, making six for the day. BNBUSDT and SOLUSDT still have zero daily highs above spot anywhere in sixty days, so no target exists to measure reward against, and BNB's spread has just widened to 35.78 bps, past the 25 bps limit. No short is available either: four of five contracts extended this hour and the complex is up 5.6% to 9.7% on the day, so shorting here would be a reaction to nothing.

evidence.observed: AGAINST the long, and this was the precondition the 22:00 note named. XRPUSDT's recovery from the 14:05Z failed breakout ran 14:15Z through 15:05Z. Within it the largest single 5m bar is 671,693,897 at 14:55Z and it is a down bar: open 1.5022, high 1.5039, low 1.4945, close 1.4963. The second largest, 629,127,190 at 14:45Z, is an up bar, and the bar that actually made the new high, 15:05Z, traded only 435,222,016 - less than the rejection bar that preceded it. On the hourly frame the 14Z hour that reclaimed the range printed 4,055,848,100 against 4,089,988,720 in the 13Z hour, so participation contracted on the reclaim. The 22:00 condition was 'volume on the up bars rather than the down ones'; the heaviest bar in the window is the down bar and the new high came on lighter trade than the rejection before it.

PRESENT BUT NOT HOLDING. XRPUSDT did clear both levels named in advance: the 15:05Z 5m bar opened 1.4970, printed a new 24h high of 1.5077 and closed 1.5049, above the 1.4969 prior high of the 11Z hour and well above the 1.4894 daily high of 09-14 that it had lost at 14:05Z. That is a genuine reclaim of a failed breakout. But it is eight minutes old at decision time and already fading: the 15:10Z bar printed 1.5031 and the book at 15:13:50Z was 1.5014/1.5015, below the 15:05Z close. More than half the breakout bar has been retraced while this decision was being written. The strategy states that a breakout after the US open which has not held is not evidence yet, and the same 14Z hour contains a completed failed breakout in the other direction (1.4891 down to 1.4765), so this tape has already reversed once within the hour.

The complex resumed higher after the single down hour the 22:00 note flagged: at 23:00 SOLUSDT +9.742% (was +8.82% at 22:00), XRPUSDT +8.516% (7.18%), BTCUSDT +6.755% (5.67%), BNBUSDT +6.036% (5.04%), ETHUSDT +5.631% (5.67%). Four of five gained and XRP recovered from weakest of the five back to second strongest, which is the relative-strength reading the strategy asks for and it is positive. Recorded explicitly as ONE category: the higher-timeframe trend reading for XRP - a day of higher highs from 1.4042 - is the same underlying observation as 'the complex is up today', and the strategy counts a moving average and a trend line over the same candles as one item, not two. The 22:00 note made the same ruling. So the long rests on market_context plus an unheld price_action item, with volume pointing the other way.

considered_and_rejected.long_XRPUSDT: The candidate of the hour and the closest call of the day. Ask 1.5015 at 15:13:50Z, spread 0.67 bps - the tightest book on the watchlist. Target 1.5270, the 2026-08-24 daily high, the nearest valid overhead level, +1.70%. Every structurally honest stop fails or barely ties: 1.4700, the prior structural low used all day, gives 0.70 net; 1.4765, the low of the 14:05Z failed breakout that this leg reversed from, gives 0.86; 1.4880, just below the 1.4894 level of 09-14 that price reclaimed, gives exactly 1.50 - on the floor, with no margin. Stretching the target to 1.5441 with the 1.4880 stop reaches 2.60, but that asks for another +2.8% inside the 24-hour limit and is a target chosen to satisfy arithmetic, which the 22:00 note rejected for the same reason on the short side. The only comfortable constructions use stops at 1.4930 or 1.4940 (1.93 and 2.44 net), and those are stops fitted to a size: 1.4945 was the low of both the 14:55Z and 15:00Z bars, so such a stop sits five to fifteen ticks under a price printed within the last fifteen minutes, while the last twelve 5m bars average 0.0058 of range and two of them ranged 0.0094 and 0.0107, more than the whole stop distance. Declined on three independent grounds, any one of which is sufficient: the named volume precondition failed; the breakout is eight minutes old and has already retraced past the 15:05Z close; and the geometry is upside-down, with a 1.70% target sitting inside the contract's own 1.83% hourly range while the 0.90% stop sits inside one hourly bar - price traded 1.4792, below that stop, 65 minutes ago. Finally the 1.50 print itself is suspect: at 15:10Z the ask was 1.5025 and the identical construction printed 1.46, below the floor; it cleared only because price drifted 0.0010 lower in three minutes. The 22:00 note warned in advance against exactly this - a fall that clears the floor by pushing the entry down is worth less than one where the evidence also arrives.
considered_and_rejected.long_ETHUSDT: Rejected, and now the clearest rejection of the day. The 22:00 note made ETH the contract to re-check first and named the threshold precisely: an ask of 2722.68 or lower for 1.50 net on the unchanged 2693.00 stop and 2771.00 target, with roughly 2710 needed for real margin. It moved the wrong way, to an ask of 2745.69 at 15:13Z - 23.01 above the threshold, no longer a near miss. Risk 53.74 against reward 24.21 gives 0.38 net. That is a fifth consecutive failure on the same arithmetic: 1.34, 0.55, 1.40, 0.45, 0.38. The structure is unchanged and valid, with 2771.00 real overhead and 2693.00 a real floor, but ETH has rallied into the middle of that pocket and there is no version of this trade that works from here. Volume gives no help either; the 15Z bars are thin.
considered_and_rejected.long_BNBUSDT: Rejected, unchanged and now worse. The 60-day daily scan re-run at the current ask of 803.53 returns ZERO daily highs above spot - BNB is at a 60-day high, so no overhead reference exists and there is nothing to measure reward against. Separately, its spread has widened to 35.78 bps at 15:13Z, past the 25 bps configured limit, which alone disqualifies it. The engine would reject it on spread before any thesis was considered.
considered_and_rejected.long_SOLUSDT: Rejected, unchanged. The strongest contract of the five on the day at +9.742% and the one that extended through the 22:00 pullback, but the 60-day scan at the current ask of 118.63 returns ZERO daily highs above spot. Strength without an overhead reference is not a tradeable setup: a target has to exist before reward/risk means anything. Spread 5.06 bps is fine; that is not the problem.
considered_and_rejected.long_BTCUSDT: Rejected. Its spread recovered from 15.37 bps at 22:00 to 2.78 bps, so the book complaint has eased, but the structural one is now worse: the 60-day scan finds exactly one daily high above spot, 95804.10, and this hour proved it is an artifact by printing it twice - identical 11.6% and 11.1% upper wicks at 14:35Z and 14:40Z with no counterpart on any other contract. Excluding it leaves no overhead reference at all, so BTC is in the same position as BNB and SOL, with six artifacts on top.

decision.lessons_applied: None available: 05-交易记录-data/reviews/LESSONS.md still records no lessons, because the experiment has no closed trades yet. That file was read, and nothing under reviews/ was modified - the 22:00 daily review owns that folder and may be running concurrently. The guidance actually carried forward is the 22:00 research note's next-task focus, followed item by item and treated as binding rather than advisory. Item 1 made ETHUSDT the contract to re-check first and named 2722.68 as the threshold: re-checked first, and it moved away to 2745.69 for 0.38 net, so it is out. Item 1 also carried two cautions, both of which bit this hour. The first, quote the price at decision time rather than claiming a pass on a drifted price, is why the book was re-read at 15:13:50Z rather than reusing the 15:10:39Z snapshot - and the re-read is what exposed that XRP's 1.50 had appeared only in the intervening three minutes. The second, that a fall which clears the floor by pushing the entry down is worth less than one where the evidence also arrives, is the direct reason XRP was declined at exactly 1.50. Item 2 set the condition for re-opening XRP as a long at 'back above 1.4894 and holding, with volume on the up bars': price cleared 1.4894, the volume half failed outright and the holding half is unproven at eight minutes, so the condition is not met even though its headline price trigger was. Item 3 kept BTC excluded and BNB and SOL untradeable for want of an overhead reference; all three were re-verified from daily bars rather than carried forward, and all three still fail, with BTC's exclusion strengthened by two fresh artifacts and BNB's by a 35.78 bps spread. The 22:00 note also flagged the complex turning lower as the single thing to watch at 23:00; it turned back up instead, which is recorded as market_context but, per that same note's ruling, as one observation with trend rather than two.
